Trigger.Name: WHEN_VALIDATE_RECORD
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 v_don VARCHAR2(5):=RTrim(LTrim(:global.donation_type));
 v_proc VARCHAR2(5):=RTrim(LTrim(:global.procedure_code));
 v_inter VARCHAR2(5):=RTrim(LTrim(:global.inter_code));
 v_date DATE:=to_date(RTrim(LTrim(:global.eff_date)),'mm-dd-yyyy');
 v_tdate DATE:=to_date(RTrim(LTrim(:global.term_date)),'mm-dd-yyyy');
BEGIN

 If :vdpc_block.donation_type is not null and :vdpc_block.procedure_code is not null and 
 :vdpc_block.inter_code is not null and :vdpc_block.eff_date is not null
 Then 
 IF :vdpc_block.donation_type=v_don and :vdpc_block.procedure_code = v_proc and 
 :vdpc_block.inter_code=v_inter and :vdpc_block.eff_date =v_date then
 NULL;
 ELSE
 
 If :vdpc_block.term_date is null or :vdpc_block.term_date > sysdate then
 If db_check(:vdpc_block.donation_type,:vdpc_block.procedure_code,:vdpc_block.inter_code,
 to_char(:vdpc_block.eff_date,'mm-dd-yyyy'))
 Then
 show_error('13002');
 check_package_failure; 
 Else
 If NVL(:vdpc_block.donation_type,'') !=NVL(v_don,'') OR
 NVL(:vdpc_block.procedure_code,'') !=NVL(v_proc,'') OR
 NVL(:vdpc_block.inter_code,'') !=NVL(v_inter,'') OR
 NVL(:vdpc_block.eff_date,'') !=v_date 
 Then
 If v_don is not null and v_proc is not null and v_inter is not null and v_date is not null then
 DUP_DELETE_RG(v_don,v_proc,v_inter,to_char(v_date),to_char(v_tdate));
 End if;
 DUP_INSERT_RG(:vdpc_block.donation_type,:vdpc_block.procedure_code,:vdpc_block.inter_code,
 to_char(:vdpc_block.eff_date,'mm-dd-yyyy'),to_char(:vdpc_block.term_date,'mm-dd-yyyy'));
 End if; 
 End if; 
 End if;
 END IF;
End if;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: DUP_DELETE_RG
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE dup_delete_rg(plDon in varchar2,plProc in varchar2, plInter in varchar2,
 plEDATE in varchar2, plTDate in varchar2) IS
 rg_name VARCHAR2(20) := 'VPE'; 
 rg_col1 VARCHAR2(20) := 'VPE.DON'; 
 rg_col2 VARCHAR2(20) := 'VPE.PROC';
 rg_col3 VARCHAR2(20) := 'VPE.INTER'; 
 rg_col4 VARCHAR2(20) := 'VPE.EDATE'; 
 rg_col5 VARCHAR2(20) := 'VPE.TDATE'; 
 rg_id RecordGroup; 
 gc_id GroupColumn; 
 rowcount NUMBER; 
BEGIN 
 rg_id := Find_Group( rg_name ); 
 IF NOT Id_Null(rg_id) THEN 
 rowcount:=GET_GROUP_ROW_COUNT('VPE');
 --message(to_char(rowcount));pause;
 For i in 1.. rowcount Loop
 If Get_Group_Char_cell(rg_col1,i) = plDon AND
 Get_Group_Char_cell(rg_col2,i) = plProc AND
 Get_Group_Char_cell(rg_col3,i) = plInter AND
 Get_Group_Char_cell(rg_col4,i) = plEDate AND
 NVL(Get_Group_Char_cell(rg_col5,i),'X') = nvl(plTDate,'X') then
 delete_group_row(rg_id,i);
 exit;
 End if;
 End Loop;
 END IF; 
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: TOOLBAR
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PACKAGE BODY TOOLBAR IS

 cs VARCHAR2(20);
 csscale NUMBER;

 PROCEDURE hide_function IS
 BEGIN
 Set_Item_Property('banner.TEXT',DISPLAYED,PROPERTY_OFF);
 IF NOT Id_Null(Find_Timer('ENTER_TOOLBAR')) THEN
 Delete_Timer('ENTER_TOOLBAR');
 END IF;
 END; /* hide_function */

 PROCEDURE set_timer IS
 t Timer;
 BEGIN
 :banner.system_name := :SYSTEM.MOUSE_ITEM;
 IF NOT Id_Null(Find_Timer('ENTER_TOOLBAR')) THEN
 Delete_Timer('ENTER_TOOLBAR');
 END IF;
 t := Create_Timer('ENTER_TOOLBAR',250,NO_REPEAT);
 END; /* set_timer */

 PROCEDURE show_function IS
 w NUMBER;
 BEGIN
 :toolbar.Text := Get_Item_Property(item_name, LABEL);
 w := dll.tblen(:toolbar.text)*tbscale/100000*csscale;
 Set_Item_Property('TOOLBAR.TEXT',WIDTH,w);
 Set_Item_Property('TOOLBAR.TEXT',POSITION,
 to_number(Get_Item_Property(item_name,X_POS)),
 to_number(Get_Item_Property(item_name,Y_POS)) +
 to_number(Get_Item_Property(item_name,HEIGHT)));
 Set_Item_Property('TOOLBAR.TEXT',DISPLAYED,PROPERTY_ON);
 END; /* show_function */

BEGIN

 cs := Get_Form_Property(Get_Application_Property(CURRENT_FORM_NAME),COORDINATE_SYSTEM);
 IF cs = 'INCHES' THEN csscale := 1;
 ELSIF cs = 'PIXELS' THEN csscale := 120;
 ELSIF cs = 'POINTS' THEN csscale := 72;
 ELSIF cs = 'CENTIMETERS' THEN csscale := 2.56;
 ELSIF cs = 'CHARACTER_CELL' THEN
 csscale := Get_Form_Property(Get_Application_Property(CURRENT_FORM_NAME),CHARACTER_CELL_WIDTH);
 csscale := 140/csscale;
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: DUP_INSERT_RG
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE dup_insert_rg(plDon in varchar2,plProc in varchar2, plInter in varchar2,
 plEDate in varchar2,plTDate in varchar2) IS

 rg_name VARCHAR2(20) := 'VPE'; 
 rg_col1 VARCHAR2(20) := 'VPE.DON'; 
 rg_col2 VARCHAR2(20) := 'VPE.PROC';
 rg_col3 VARCHAR2(20) := 'VPE.INTER'; 
 rg_col4 VARCHAR2(20) := 'VPE.EDATE'; 
 rg_col5 VARCHAR2(20) := 'VPE.TDATE'; 
 rg_id RecordGroup; 
 gc_id GroupColumn; 
 rowcount NUMBER; 
 DUP_RECORD VARCHAR2(1):='N';
 VCount NUMBER:=0;
BEGIN 
 rg_id := Find_Group( rg_name ); 
 IF NOT Id_Null(rg_id) THEN 
 rowcount:=GET_GROUP_ROW_COUNT('VPE');
 FOR i in 1 .. rowcount Loop

 If Get_Group_Char_cell(rg_col1,i) = plDon AND
 Get_Group_Char_cell(rg_col2,i) = plProc AND
 Get_Group_Char_cell(rg_col3,i) = plInter then
 if (sysdate between to_date(Get_Group_Char_cell(rg_col4,i),'mm-dd-yyyy') and
 nvl( to_date(Get_Group_Char_cell(rg_col5,i),'mm-dd-yyyy'),sysdate+1)) OR
 (to_date(Get_Group_Char_cell(rg_col4,i),'mm-dd-yyyy') > sysdate)
 then
 DUP_RECORD:='Y'; 
 exit;
 end if;
 End if; 
 End Loop;

 If DUP_RECORD ='Y' then 
 show_error('13002');
 check_package_failure; 
 Else

 Add_Group_Row( rg_id, END_OF_GROUP ); 
 Set_Group_Char_Cell( rg_col1, rowcount+1, plDon); 
 Set_Group_Char_Cell( rg_col2, rowcount+1, plProc); 
 Set_Group_Char_Cell( rg_col3, rowcount+1, plInter); 
 Set_Group_Char_Cell( rg_col4, rowcount+1, plEDATE); 
 Set_Group_Char_Cell( rg_col5, rowcount+1, plTDATE); 
 End if;
 END IF; 
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: DB_CHECK
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION db_check (plDon in varchar2,plProc in varchar2, plInter in VARCHAR2,plEDATE in varchar2) RETURN BOOLEAN IS
 vCount NUMBER:=0;
BEGIN

 select nvl(count(*),0) into vCount from valid_proc_exclusions where
 donation_type = plDon and procedure_code = plProc and
 inter_code = plInter and 
 sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1);

 IF vCount > 0 then 
 RETURN (TRUE);
 ELSE
 RETURN (FALSE);
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: DUP_REC_VALIDATION
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE dup_rec_validation IS
 v_don VARCHAR2(5):=RTrim(LTrim(:global.donation_type));
 v_proc VARCHAR2(5):=RTrim(LTrim(:global.procedure_code));
 v_inter VARCHAR2(5):=RTrim(LTrim(:global.inter_code));
 v_date DATE:=to_date(RTrim(LTrim(:global.eff_date)),'mm-dd-yyyy');
 v_tdate DATE:=to_date(RTrim(LTrim(:global.term_date)),'mm-dd-yyyy');
BEGIN

 If :vdpc_block.donation_type is not null and :vdpc_block.procedure_code is not null and 
 :vdpc_block.inter_code is not null and :vdpc_block.eff_date is not null
 Then 
 If not check_existing_data then
 If :vdpc_block.term_date is null or :vdpc_block.term_date > sysdate then
 If db_check(:vdpc_block.donation_type,:vdpc_block.procedure_code,:vdpc_block.inter_code,
 to_char(:vdpc_block.eff_date,'mm-dd-yyyy'))
 Then
 show_error('13002');
 check_package_failure; 
 Else
 
 If NVL(:vdpc_block.donation_type,'') !=NVL(v_don,'') OR
 NVL(:vdpc_block.procedure_code,'') !=NVL(v_proc,'') OR
 NVL(:vdpc_block.inter_code,'') !=NVL(v_inter,'') OR
 NVL(:vdpc_block.eff_date,'') !=v_date 
 Then 
 -- message(v_don||' PR='||v_proc||'IN='||v_inter||' ED='||to_char(v_date)||'TD='||to_char(v_tdate));pause;
 DUP_DELETE_RG(nvl(v_don,:vdpc_block.donation_type),nvl(v_proc,:vdpc_block.procedure_code),
 nvl(v_inter,:vdpc_block.inter_code),
 nvl(to_char(v_date,'mm-dd-yyyy'),to_char(:vdpc_block.eff_date,'mm-dd-yyyy')),to_char(v_tdate));
 
 End if; 
 DUP_INSERT_RG(:vdpc_block.donation_type,:vdpc_block.procedure_code,:vdpc_block.inter_code,
 to_char(:vdpc_block.eff_date,'mm-dd-yyyy'),to_char(:vdpc_block.term_date,'mm-dd-yyyy')); 
 End if; 
 End if;
 End if;
End if;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_EXISTING_DATA
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION check_existing_data RETURN BOOLEAN IS
 v_don VARCHAR2(5):=RTrim(LTrim(:global.donation_type));
 v_proc VARCHAR2(5):=RTrim(LTrim(:global.procedure_code));
 v_inter VARCHAR2(5):=RTrim(LTrim(:global.inter_code));
 v_date DATE:=to_date(RTrim(LTrim(:global.eff_date)),'mm-dd-yyyy');
 v_tdate DATE:=to_date(RTrim(LTrim(:global.term_date)),'mm-dd-yyyy');
BEGIN
 If NVL(:vdpc_block.donation_type,'') = NVL(v_don,'') AND
 NVL(:vdpc_block.procedure_code,'') = NVL(v_proc,'') AND
 NVL(:vdpc_block.inter_code,'') = NVL(v_inter,'') AND
 NVL(:vdpc_block.eff_date,'') =v_date Then
 return (TRUE);
 Else
 return (False);
 End if; 
END;

select inter_code,inter_desc from valid_interdictions where
inter_type!='HOLDS' and deferral_flag!='Y' 
order by 1

select a.procedure_code,b.description from valid_donproc_codes a,
valid_proc_codes b where 
a.donation_type=:vdpc_block.donation_type and
a.procedure_code=b.procedure_code and
:ctrl_block.chp_sysdate between a.eff_date and nvl(a.term_date,:ctrl_block.chp_sysdate+1) order by a.procedure_code

BEGIN
 populate_chapter_ID(l_chp_id, l_print_id, l_error);
 IF l_error IS NOT NULL THEN
 IF l_error in ('9776','9777') THEN
 show_error(l_error); -- Message Type
 check_package_failure;
 ELSE
 message('Err: ' || sqlcode || '-' || SUBSTR(sqlerrm, 1, 100));
 pause;
 END IF; 
 exit_form(no_validate);
 ELSE
 :global.chapter_id := l_chp_id;
 :global.user_printer_id := l_print_id;
 END IF;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 message('Err: ' || sqlcode || '-' || SUBSTR(sqlerrm, 1, 100));pause;
 exit_form(no_validate); 
END;

 null;
